Lexical TF buries the gold document under noisy logs that repeat query words. Rerank the candidate window.
title-boost lifts chunks whose document title matches the query. Use a wide rerankTopN so gold is in the window.
rerankTopN of 5 cannot promote a document that lexical retrieval ranked 12th.
A working config on this corpus is reranker title-boost with rerankTopN 20 and no rewrite prompt.
